skills/make-it-so/playbooks/orchestrate..why: The orch CLI is excluded and the verification ledger lives in GitHub: every orch command becomes a direct store-file edit or a ledger comment on the PR, the store moves to ~/.claude/projects/<project>/, and restacks and cloud-only spawns become background agents with worktree isolation. The orch frontier command's empty-gt guard becomes an instruction. Worktree agents share one repository, so workers release their branches and the stacker frees held branches before a restack. Every agent runs on this machine, so the isolation exception covers only the coordinator's own working tree and worktree agents may read the store. The different-family verifier resolves to the models document's verifier and verifier-diff-audit roles, with a fallback line when there is no second family. Kitchen: every landing passes Autopilot-full's merge gate, and a closed gate parks in gates.md for the chef; human-in-the-loop units become local Projects threads running visual-grilling, with plain-text grilling as the fallback; a marker sentence says the Projects coordinator plus routines replace the /loop wakes and points at the Projects kit (the coordinator brief and routine prompts) in skills/setup-milliways/projects/. Reflect: ends with the Reflect step every make-it-so playbook ends with, which files a garden issue for each thing the thread worked around (spec #66). No stacks (spec #66 story 42): Stack safety becomes Merge safety, where each unit is one PR off trunk, dependent units are merge-then-branch, the frontier is recomputed with gh instead of gt, and one lander replaces the stacker.

skills/make-it-so/SKILL.md.why: Router: renamed make-it-so and made the kitchen's entry point, reached through the root AGENTS.md line, so the sticky-mode frontmatter (mode, icon, color, reminder) goes and the description says when to route. Routing rule: running something can answer it -> prototype; a one-way door or taste, intent or domain words only the chef holds -> grill, visual-grilling first; bigger than one context -> wayfinder; human-in-the-loop work runs as a local Projects thread with a plain-text fallback. Overlap wiring: Matt's implement, tdd, diagnosing-bugs, code-review, prototype and grilling are the procedures for their jobs; tdd-bug-fix stays for bugs, interrogate for one-way doors, and the Spec and tickets playbook is listed. Every playbook ends with Reflect. No stacks: Autopilot-stack is not listed (its playbook is deleted), and Orchestrate and multi-phase plans no longer say stacked PRs. Autonomy: merges follow the trust ladder's merge gate, and one-way doors always wait for the chef. Model-invocable: milliways:poteto-agent preloads it, and Claude Code cannot preload a skill with model invocation off. Roles: the Subagents defaults resolve from docs/agents/models.md (written by setup-milliways) instead of setup-pstack and Cursor model slugs. Leaf skills: says where principle leaves and this skill's own files live (<milliways>), since Claude Code does not list skills with model invocation off.

skills/pr/SKILL.md.why: PR anatomy: keeps Summary, Evidence and Merge Danger, and adds a conventional-commit title, a calldiff call-tree summary sanity-checked for dynamic dispatch (Mermaid as fallback), a scope line, before/after media attached with gh --attach, the red-then-green test, a Blast radius: high|medium|low line with the one fact it is safe because of, the door:one-way label, commits regrouped in dependency order, the verifier verdict at the head SHA with its tier label, a decision-log link and the Fix-forward: #N line, which the trust-ladder scorer reads. One concern per PR, no stacks. Adds the Prototype PRs variant: a draft titled prototype: with a screencast per variant, closed unmerged with the chef's pick recorded on the PR and the ticket.
